events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 31 (today)): Ryan added Michael Carter (RB, TEN) (dropped Julian Hill (TE, NE)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (yesterday)): Drew added Michael Trigg (TE, DAL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (yesterday)): Drew added Deion Burks (WR, IND).
TRADE (Oct 30 (yesterday)): Corbishley receives A.J. Brown (WR, NE), Jordan Mason (RB, MIN), 2028 R2 pick. Drew receives Breece Hall (RB, NYJ), 2027 R2 pick.
TRADE (Oct 30 (yesterday)): Drew receives 2027 R1 pick, 2028 R2 pick. Kevin receives Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF), 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 28 (3 days ago)): Jake added Reggie Virgil (WR, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 28 (3 days ago)): Fronge added Elijah Mitchell (RB, PHI) for $12 FAAB.
CUT (Oct 28 (3 days ago)): Fronge released Athan Kaliakmanis (QB, WAS).

WEEK 7 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Shaq, 157.3-155.6 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Drew, 113.5-99.1; Fronge def. Ryan, 121.0-114.6; Wingard def. Charles, 117.7-107.3; Kevin def. Jake, 125.8-117.4; Mitchum def. Brent, 136.2-125.6

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Kevin vs Mitchum is live and RDC is out to a 34.0-0.0 lead. The team that just added Christian McCaffrey is not wasting time making a statement.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: 34-0 KEVIN. MITCHUM. ZERO. The board gave DEEP an 8.4% surge and $102.21 and they are currently putting up a goose egg against the hottest team in the league. SOMEBODY EXPLAIN THE VALUATION TO ME.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I had Mitchum on my card this week and I am watching that 34.0-0.0 score in real time wondering what exactly I saw in DEEP that justified the confidence. The $102.21 price tag looked like a signal. It was not a signal.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Wingard is up 17.4-0.0 on Fronge and I just need everyone to remember I picked Wingard this week. That's going on my record. The Havana headquarters did not help ForgeHammer one bit today.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Kevin ascent before anyone else on this panel was willing to say it out loud, and right now RDC is up 34-0 on a 10-4 team. The McCaffrey acquisition was not a flex — it was a closing argument.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Drew is 0-14, added Michael Trigg and Deion Burks off waivers yesterday, and just scored 33.6 points in the first quarter against Brent. I want a segment on whether ATLAS is actually better than their record or whether Brent is just that cooperative.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Three games live, three games with one team already on zero, and the most chaotic roster in the league quietly hanging 33 on Obsidian. The Ledger is going to have a lot to say about Week 8 before Thursday.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Shaq is up 17.3-0.0 on Jake and Monarch Wideout Bank at $88.36 — down 9.5% on the exchange — might be telling a different story on the scoreboard than the market expected. MWB sitting at 7-7 with WR depth playing like this is genuinely dangerous in a seven-team playoff.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Terrence is 5-7 on the season and just announced he picked Wingard like it earns him something. Terrence, you are one game above the pace that gets you removed from the panel. Win first, gloat second.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Ryan adds Michael Carter off the free agent wire on the same morning his team is sitting in Week 8 with a 7-7 record. AEGIS is at $124.07 flat — not a penny of movement — and the defending champions are three games out of first. Carter is fine. The situation is not fine.
